narrative.title: The Kiosk's Float Minimizer
narrative.scenario: A self-service kiosk holds unlimited stock of each coin denomination in its hopper and must dispense exact change for every refund request. Maintenance wants the hopper emptied as rarely as possible, so the firmware computes the fewest coins per payout. Some amounts simply cannot be formed from the available denominations, and the kiosk must flag those too.
narrative.inputFormat: An array coins of distinct denominations and an integer amount.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the fewest number of coins summing to amount, or -1 when it cannot be formed. Each denomination may be used unlimited times.

testCases.explanation: Odd amounts are unreachable using only 2s.

hintLevels: Level 1: The last coin paid is some denomination c — the rest is the best answer for amount - c.
Level 2: best[a] = 1 + min over c <= a of best[a - c]; the coin may repeat, so stay on the same row.
Level 3: Seed best[0] = 0, treat unreachable amounts as infinity, and convert infinity to -1 at the end.
